captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a vintage-style capsule and candy vending machine. It features a transparent, spherical glass hopper on top with a red lid and grey knob, sitting on a cream-colored rectangular lower body with red accents and a black base. On the side, a grey dispensing wheel with a red handle is mounted, designed to rotate continuously, while a flat cream-colored front service panel is hinged to swing outward.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact capsule-and-candy vending machine. The model should include a clear spherical hopper with a red lid, a rectangular cream-colored body on a black base, a side-mounted grey dispensing wheel with a red handle that rotates continuously, and an articulated front service panel that swings open on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining an ArticulatedObject. The main body is built from combined box and cylinder primitives representing the cream cabinet, red top trim, and black base. A spherical visual represents the clear hopper, capped with a red cylinder lid. The dispensing wheel on the side is modeled as a grey cylinder with a smaller red cylinder handle, attached via a continuous joint. The front service panel is created as a flat box plate and attached to the main body using a revolute joint on a vertical side hinge.
